attributes.reducer: ($p := $action.payload; $ob := $state.outbox ? $state.outbox : []; $action.type = "save" ? $merge([$state, {"items": $append($state.items, [$p]), "outbox": $p.lat ? $append($ob, [{"id": $p.id, "op": "add", "lat": $p.lat, "lon": $p.lon, "data": $p}]) : $ob}]) : $action.type = "remove" ? ($it := $state.items[id = $p]; $merge([$state, {"items": [$state.items[id != $p]], "outbox": $it.placeId ? $append($ob, [{"id": "d-" & $p, "op": "delete", "place": $it.placeId}]) : $ob}])) : $action.type = "report" ? $merge([$state, {"outbox": $append($ob, [{"id": "r-" & $p, "op": "report", "place": $p}]), "erreur": "Merci, signalement envoyé."}]) : $action.type = "place:ok" ? $merge([$state, {"outbox": [$ob[id != $p.id]], "items": [$state.items.($p.op = "add" and id = $p.id ? $merge([$, {"placeId": $p.placeId}]) : $)], "erreur": $p.op = "report" ? "Merci, signalement envoyé." : ""}]) : $action.type = "place:error" ? $merge([$state, {"outbox": [$ob[id != $p.id]], "erreur": "Partage impossible : " & $p.error}]) : $state)
